title: The night Europe thought the sky was on fire 🔥
subject: aurora
description:
Would you have thought it was the end of the world? 👇

On January 25, 1938, a massive solar storm painted a crimson aurora over Europe, North Africa and North America. Firefighters were called out, radio went dead, and some people thought war had started.

Sources: Wikipedia, "January 1938 geomagnetic storm"; TIME, "Science: Great Aurora" (February 7, 1938); The New York Times, January 26, 1938, "Aurora Borealis Startles Europe; People Flee in Fear, Call Firemen."
tags: could a solar storm happen again

scenes.text: The night sky over Europe turned crimson.
January 25, 1938. Guards at Windsor Castle called the fire brigade to put out the glow.
Salzburg's firefighters got the same calls. In France, people shouted, "C'est la guerre!" It's war.
It was a massive solar storm. The light reached Gibraltar, Sicily and Bermuda, where people thought a ship was burning at sea.
In Canada, shortwave radio went silent for almost 12 hours.
Scientists in Grenoble said Western Europe hadn't seen a sky like it since 1709.
